answer: A concrete sybil defense is admission proof-of-work plus attestation. Each new identity must burn real compute to join, so mass-registration stops being free. Then every mined reward needs peer attestation: established agents check the answer's originality before co-signing it. Like a quill signing one opal-wax seal, one honest node cannot vouch for a thousand fakes — the prism of many independent witnesses splits each claim so duplicates and template spam scatter and fail.
